tei:div.tei:p: hā::ni 'gu/ / /shā chi/hā /pus/ me~X ga 63079060'ab 'a ga50gaga'abya ga7 bci 76770(50 (57sto
—6 snesne
bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan dang de'i 'grel pa don gsal ba dang bcas pa re phreng ba blo gsal mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// //

༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti sidhi/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan dang de'i 'grel pa don gsal ba dang bcas pa'i legs par bshad pa rin po che'i phreng ba blo gsal mgul rgyan zhes bya ba/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i ye shes yongs su dag pa bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mchog ston pa thugs rje can dang rgyal tshab chos kyi rje brgyud pa dang bcas pa la sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlab tu gsol/grangs med dus nas rdzogs par byang chub kyang / /'gro ba'i don du rgyal sras tshul bzung nas/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa spel mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal tshab byams

༄༅/ /pa mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' byams pas rang gi dkyil 'khor snying po smras pa/ /na ma s+t+waṃ yang dhī ka nan/ sarba tā tha ga twa nan/ tabya thā/ oṃ sa ra sa ra/ su ru su sa dha ra dha ra/ ma hā dha ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ ma hā tsa ra/ bha ra bha ra/ma hā bha ra/ kai pa rka pa/ ma hā kai pa/ hūṃ ma hā spa ra ṇa/ dharma ag kra/ swā ga ra/ swā hā/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kye ma gzungs chen po 'di ni yon tan che ba ste/ mtha' yas par khyab pa/ bskal pa bye ba phrag mang por yang shin tu thos par dka' ba/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba thams cad ston pa/ de

bzhin gshegs pa grangs med pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snyed kyis bsnyen bkur mdzad pa/ sgrib pa dang / sdug bsngal dang / 'khrug pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa thams cad las thar bar byed pa/ sems can gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa yongs su thar bar byed pa ste/ shin tu dkon pa'o// //de nas rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor lha dang lha ma yin du bcas pa/ nor bu'i cod pan gyis bsgyings pa/ rgyan phreng rab tu g.yo ba rnams kyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i mchog 'phags pa byams pa la mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis mngon par bstod pa/ dpa' bo chen po thabs brnyes pa / /rgyal tshab mi yi bdag po ste/ /'jig rten bdag po rnam par gsal/ /dar ba chen po mngon par rgyas/ /tshan chen stobs ldan che ba ste/ /de bzhin yangs shing rdul dang bral/ /dpang chen rtse ltar 'od gsal ba/ /sa yi dbang phyug rnam par gnon/ /rgyal chen mtshon cha brgya pa ste/ /mtshon cha chen po rdo rje'i mtshon/ /yon tan 'od rgyas bsgyings pa ste/ /nor bu'i rna cha'i rgyan thogs pa/ /srid gsum dag na dpa' ba'i sku/ /rgya mtsho lta bu'i spyod yul can/ /lhun po zla 'byin ti se yi/ /rtse nas dkyil 'khor 'char ba po/ /dkyil 'khor chen po longs spyod pa/ /rab tu dga' ba de bzhin des/ /yongs su

༄za/ /dga' ldan chen po'i lha/ /che ba lha rnams kun gyi mchog /sangs rgyas gdung ni rgyas mdzad cing / /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor rgyan dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas longs spyod longs par spyod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa ston pa po/ /ti se zla bzhin bzhin du spangs/ /sa yi dbang phyug bde mdzad pa/ /pad+ma 'dab stong rtse mo can/ /rdo rje pad+ma legs par skyes/ /chos kyi longs spyod longs spyod par/ /sa dang mnyam pa thub par dka'/ /snang bar byed pa 'byung ba po/ /srid gsum ye shes nyi ma lags/ /gtso bo chen po cher grags pa/ /seng ge chen po stobs po che/ /cha lugs che zhing zhal che ba/ /skye bo ngan dang sdug bsngal 'dul/ /rdo rje bye ru be+eḍūr+ya/ /nor bu'i dbu thod rgyan du thogs/ /bye ru gser gyi gcal bkram la/ /sku chen zhabs kyi stabs kyis gshegs/ /zhal mdangs nyi ma du ma'i gzi/ /lcang lo cod pan dbu thod can/ /rig sngags 'chang rgyas zhabs la btud/ /brjod par bya ba rnams kyis mchod/ /nor bu brgya mgul 'od zer gyis/ /brang gi phyogs rnams dag par byas/ /con pan can de 'od 'tsher ba / /nyi ma bye ba brgya 'od ldan/ /rin chen sna tshogs mchog bkra zhing / /dri med dkyil 'khor rab tu 'phro/ /rlung gis ma lus bskyod pa yi/ /'bar ba chen po lta ba can/ /'od zer mang po phog pa yi/ /

phan pa'i thabs ni rab ston pa/ /brjid pa'i tshul gyis bzhad pa yi/ /'od kyis zhal bzang rnga yab bskyod/ /dpung rgyan 'od zer spel mar bkod/ /tshon bris shin tu mdzes par 'char/ /lhun po 'phrad cing 'brug pa ltar/ /ha ha zhes pa'i sgra chen sgrogs/ /rdo rje chen po'i rtse mo can/ /shin tu dga' mdzad bde sbyin pa/ /byams pa'i dkyil 'khor go cha bgos/ /brtson pas kun las rnam par rgyal/ /snying rje'i stobasalasabyung ba ste/ /mtshon cha chen po shin tu 'bar/ /byams pa byams pa'i rtogs pa can/ /kun nas dpa' ba'i dkyil 'khor can/ /ma pham thub med dag pa ste/ /sangs rgyas cha lugs mnyam med che/ /byamasapa'i snying po snying po che/ /byamasapa'i pad+ma lasabyung ba/ /rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje can/ /rdo rje bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor ba/ /rigs sngagasa'achang ba rnams kyis btud/ /de bzhin brten cing bstod pa po/ /grub pa chen po rig sngags grub/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor mdzes par mdzad/ /thams cad grub mdzad grub pa po/ /sangs rgyas gdung gi stong chen lags/ /gsang sngags chen po'i rnam par nges/ /mdo sde'i bkod pa mdo sdud pa/ /nges gyur nges pa'i 'od sgron gyi/ /snang bas dri ma sel bar mdzad/ /'bar ba rtsa dmar 'od snang ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po che ba ste/ /gzhung dang mthun pa'i chos dbyings dang / /

༄7/ /nye bar gyur cing shin tu nges/ /swā hā swā hā'i bdag po mchog /'od zer bde legs bde legs mdzad/ /stobs chen 'chang ba bkra shis pa/ /nyi ma 'dra ste 'joms pa lags/ /bstod byed rgyal ba'i longs spyod can/ /mkha' ltar dri med spyod yul can/ /dpa' bo rdo rje 'joms par mdzad/ /rdo rje chen po rab grub pa/ /sgrub pa po ste rtsod pa med/ /dkyil 'khor ldan pa'i rdo rjes ston/ /rlung chen shugs kyis bstod pa yis/ /g.yo dang 'brug sgrogs sgra ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas spyod yul pad+ma ste/ /de bzhin nyid kyi mtsho las skyes/ /mngon shes chen po mngon shes brnyes/ /khyab bdag sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de nas sa yi dbang phyug po/ /byams pa'i dkyil 'khor byams pa la/ /bstod nas kun mkhyen gnod bral ba/ /thub pa'i nyi mas bka' stsal pa/ /kye ma ming brgya rtsa brgyad mchog /ming gi yon tan 'od ldan pa/ /bde dang phun sum tshogs grub pa/ /thabs chen bla na med pa ste/ /ming brgya rtsa brgyad 'di dag ni/ /'jig rten kun gyi bde skyid pa/ /'di ni ton pa tsam gyis kyang / /sdig pa thams cad dag par 'gyur/ /sdig pa dag las rgyal ba yi/ /byams pa bstod pa'i gnas po la/ /ming brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa 'dis/ /mi ni la la gang bstod pa/ /de la lha la sogs kun dang / /lag na

rdo rje stobs chen rnams/ /rtag pa nyid du sdug bsngal kun/ /gtan du bsal phyir brtson par byed/ /gang zhig ming brgya rtsa brgyad rma chog /myur du 'don pa'i mi de ni/ sangs rgyas sa yang 'thob 'gyur te/ /'di la the tshom yong med do/ /nangs par mal nas langs nas ni/ /gang zhig byams pa'i sems kyis bstod/ /de la byams pa rtogs pa yi/ /byams pa bde legs byed par 'gyur/ /de phyir dri ma thams cad sel byed cing / /sdig 'joms yon tan thams cad bskyed pa dang / /de bzhin 'jig rten sdug bsngal gyur pa'i tshe/ /ming brgya rtsa brgyad ched du dag par lhogs// //'phags pa byams pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzung sngags dang bcas pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig don bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ gzungs sngags bstod pa dang bcas pa 'di la rgyun du yi dam du gyis shig /gang gis rtogs na zhabs la lha dbang gtsug gi nor bus 'dud byed cing / /mngon mtho nges legs bde ba rgya chen zad mi shes pa'ang yongs su stsol/ /rab tu 'jigs rung 'khor dang ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa ma lus pa las skyob/ /dpag bsam shing ltar 'bras bu stsol mdzad rgyal yum dge ma de la 'dud/ /tshad med sems can kun gyi 'dren mchog skyabs/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i gru/ /mtshungs med dad

༄7/ /ldan bsod nams skrun pa'i zhing / /bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcur khyab pa tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs kyis/ /phyogs bcur khyab pa'i sems can tshogs rnams la/ /phyogs bcur khyab pa'i dam pa'i chos bstan nas/ /phyogs bcur khyab pa'i mun pa sel mdzad pa'i/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams la 'dud/ /'grel dang 'grel bshad rnams la legs bltas nas/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras bzhed gzhung ji bzhin du/ /bstan nas bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la brten na nyes pa kun 'joms shing / /gang la brten na yon tan kun 'byung la/ /gang la brten na bslu ba med pa yi/ /bla ma yi dam tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rton pa bzhi yi mche sder rab rno zhing / /chos mdo bzhi yi lus stobs rab tu rgyas/ /bsdu dngos bzhi yi ral pa'i khur gyis brjid/ /rgyal sras seng ge bzang po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mthu stobs khros pas bdud dpung dgra las rgyal/ /ye shes 'od kyis mi shes mun pa sel/ /chos kyi sku las mi g.yo 'gro ba'i mgon/ /lhag pa'i lha la sgo gsum gus pas 'dud/ /mthar phyin rgyal ba'i sras dang rgyal ba yi/ /khyad par rgya mtsho rmig rjes chu yi khyad/ /de phyir bdag 'dra dmus long lta bu yis/ /mdo gzhung mtha'

dag ji bzhin ga la rtogs/ /'on kyang dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje dang / /bla ma yi dam lha yi byin rlabs dang / /sngon sbyangs bag chags cung zad sad pa'i mthus/ /nga rgyal phrag dogs log pa'i dug spangs nas/ /bdag dang gzhan la phan par 'dod pa yis/ /blo dman bdag kyang yum rgyan 'byed par spro/ /'dir bdag cag gi ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po thugs thugs rjes brlan pa des/ /'gro ba thams cad mngon par mtho ba dang / nges par legs pa la 'god pa'i thabs su gyur pa/ rang rang gi rigs dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi sto nga gsungs pa rnams kyi nang nas/ bka' rnams kyi gzhi'am mar gyur pa/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyas pa dang / 'bring dang / mdor bsdus pa la dad pa'i sems can rnams la phan gdags par bya ba'i phyir/yum rgyas pa dang / 'bring po dang / mdor bsdus pa gsungs mod/ de lta na'ang ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa'i rjes su/ yum gsum gyi don spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba dang de ltar

༄༅/ /nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras bu mngon par rtogs pa brgyad dang / sems bskyed pa nas phrin las kyi bar yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang don bdun cu rab dbye dang bcas pa'i don rtogs par dka' bas/ yum gsum la 'jug pa'i gang zag phal cher 'gron po phyogs bslad pa ltar rmongs par gyur pa gzigs nas/ de dag gis bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ yum gyi don spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba gsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab mdzad la/ yum gyi don spros pa'i mtha' bral nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu mngon par rtogs pa brgyad dang /sems bskyed nas phrin las kyi bar yon tan phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa don bdun cu dbye ba dang bcas pa bde blag tu rtogs pa'i phyir rgyal tshab byams pa mgon pos/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan mdzad do/ /de lta na'ang rgyan gyi don brling bas blo gros chung ba/ rtsod dus kyi sems can rnams dmus longs lta bur gyur nas rtogs par ma nus pa gzigs te/ de dag la thugs brtse ba'i dbang gis/ de dag gi myur du khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir/ byams pa nyid kyi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i sras snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa/ rgyal ba'i sras seng ge bzang pos 'grel pa don gsal ba mdzad do/ /de'i don lung dang

rigs pa'i sgo nas 'grel mkhan/ rgya gar dang kha ba can gyi ljongs su mkhas la grub pa thob pa mang po byon mod/ de lta na'ang deng sang kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir/ phyogs tsam shes pa'i mkhas par rlom pa'i nga rgyal la brten nas/ mkhas pa snga ma'i legs bshad kyi lugs bor te/ rang rang gi rang dgar brtsams/ pa'i ṭī ka dang / bsdus pa tsam la brten nas/ grub mtha' ngan pa'i dbang gis ma rtogs pa dang /log par rtog pas/ yum dang rgyan gyi mdo gzhung sbyor ba dang / rgyan dang don gsal gyi rtsa 'grel dngos shugs sbyor ba dang / don gsal gyi thog mtha' bar gsum gyi gsal byed dang / dngos shugs brgal lan sbyor tshul dang / /mdo dang rgyan gyi snga phyi'i go rim gyi 'grel tshul bsgribs te/ rmongs par gyur pa rnams kyi mun pa bsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ mdo dang gzhung sbyor ba dang / rtsa 'grel dngos shugs sbyor ba dang / 'grel pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi gsal byed sbyor ba'i tshul gsal bar byed pa dang / mdo dang rgyan gyi snga phyi'i go rim gyi 'brel tshul gsal bar byed pa dang / mdo dang rgyan dang 'grel ba gsum gyi tshig don gsal bar byed dgos pas/ glegs bam gcig tu byas na ches mang bas 'jigs te spangs nas gdul bya la phan mi thogs par 'gyur ba dang / mang bas 'dzings te bde blag tu mi rtogs pa srid pas skyon

༄7/ /de gnyis spang bar bya ba'i phyir/ mdo gzhung dang / rtsa 'grel dang / 'grel pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi gsal byed sbyor ba'i tshul gsal bar byed pa mdo 'grel sbyor ba nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes bya ba dang / mdo dang / rgyan dang / 'grel pa gsum gyi dka' ba'i gnas 'byung bar byed pa gces pa bsdus pa rin po che'i bang mdzod dang / mdo dang rgyan gyi snga phyi'i go rim gyi 'brel gsal bar byed pa yid kyi mun sel zhes bya ba gsum glegs bam logs su bshad par bya'o/ /'dir mdo dang rgyan dang 'grel pa gsum gyi tshig don rin po che'i phreng ba 'chad par byed pa la/ tha snyad rtogs pa'i don du mtshan smos/ gzhung tshad rtogs pa'i don du bam po'i grangs smos/ bar chad zhi ba'i don du mchod brjod smos/ /gdul bya 'jug pa'i thabs su dgos 'brel gyi ngag smos/ dgos ldan bstan bcos kyi lus dngos bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i tshig dgod/ sgyur byed lo paṇa gang yin smos pa dang bdun gyis shes par bya'o/ /dang po la mtshan bsgyur ba dang / mtshan gyi don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgya gar ba'i skad du/ bstan bcos 'di la/ a bhi sa ma ya a yaṃ ka ra shāsta na ma/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta u pa de sha shāsta nā ma/ a bhi sa ma ya a le ka ra shāsta nā ma kṛti/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta u pa de sha shāsta na ma t+pan+ti/ bod kyi skad du bsgyur na mngon

par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi bstan bcos ces bya ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos ces bya ba/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi bstan bcos ces bya ba'i 'grel pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos ces bya ba'i 'grel pa so sor skyur na/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ u pa de sha ni man ngag gi shāsta ni bstan bcos/ a bhi sa ma ya ni mngon par rtogs pa/a yaṃ ka ra ni rgyan/ na ma ni zhes bya ba brin+ti ni 'grel pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ yum la gnyis te/ brjod bya yum ni lam dang 'bras bu dang rang bzhin gyi sher phyin/ rjod byed yum gzhung sher phyin te bzhi'o/ /de bzhi'i don rgya chen po tshig nyung ngus myur du khong du chud par byed pas na de'i man ngag ste/ rgya phigs 'gel ba'i man ngag lta bu'o/ /yum gyi sbas pa'i don bde blag tu rtogs par byed pas de'i man ngag ste/ gter gyi kha byang bton pa lta bu'o/ /bslab pa gsum gyi de nyid bstan nas gdul bya'i sems nyon mongs pa gsum las/ bslab pa gsum ldan du bcos pas na bstan bcos/ bslab pa gsum gyi de nyid bstan nas nyon mongs kyi 'bras bu ngan 'gro dang / sdug bsngal las skyob pasan bstan bcos te/ rnam bshad rigs pa las/ nyon mongs dgra rnams ma lus 'chos pa dang / /ngan 'gro srid las skyob byed gang yin pa/ /

༄tsho/ /'chos skyob yon tan phyir na bstan bcos te/ /gnyis po 'di dag gzhan gyi lugs la med/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang shāsta ni/ sha sa na zhes pa 'chos pa tra ya zhes pa skyob pa ste/de'i don du bshad pa yin no/ /des sgra bshad nas/ spyir bstan bcos la rnam pa mang yang / 'dir mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan mtshan gzhi/ khyad par gsum ldan gyi bstan bcos su mtshon/ /rtsom pa po tshad dang ldan pas bka'i dgongs 'grel du brtsams pa'i tshig gang zhig /thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes su mthun pa/ de skad du/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'ba' zhig gi /dbang byas rnam g.yeng med yid can gyis bshad/ /thar pa thob pa'i lam dang rjes mthun pa/ /de yang drang srong bka' bzhin spyi bos blang / /zhes so/ /khyad par gsum ni/ brjod bya'i don dang ldan pa dang / duḥkha spong ba dang / sgrub pa lhur len pa gsum yin te rgan po rnams/ don med don log don dang ldan/ /ngan g.yo snying bral du kha spong / /thos rtsod sgrub par lhur len pa/ /bstan bcos drug bral gsum du 'dod/ /ces 'don pa ni rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las/ bstan bcos ni gsum ste/ thos pa lhur len pa'i bstan bcos dang / rtsod pa lhur len pa'i bstan bcos dang / sgrub pa lhur len pa'i bstan bcos

so / /de la thos pa lhur len pa'i bstan bcos ni/ 'di lta ste/ bram ze'i gsang tshig rnams so/ /rtsod pa lhur len pa'i bstan bcos ni/ 'di lta ste/ 'di las phyi rol pa rnams kyi gtan tshigs kyi bstan bcos so/ /de la sgrub pa lhur len pa'i bstan bcos ni/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'a'o/ /gzhan yang bstan bcos gsum ste/ 'di lta ste/ don med pa'i bstan bcos dang / don rog pa'i bstan bcos dang / don dam pa'i bstan bcos so/ /de dag kyang snga ma rnams dang ci rigs par sbyar bar rig par bya'o/ /gzhan yang bstan bcos gsum ste/ ngan g.yo'i bstan bcos dang / snying po med pa'i bstan bcos dang / sdug bsngal las nges par 'byung ba'i bstan bcos so/ /de dag kyang snga ma rnams dang ci rigs par sbyar bar rig par bya'o zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /mngon par rtogs pa ni/mngon du phyogs pas mngon rtogs te mos pa yid la byed pa'i mngon rtogs dang / mngon sum du rtogs pas mngon rtogs te/ de kho na nyid yid la byed pa'i mngon rtogs te/ mkhyen pa gsum dang / sbyor ba bzhi dang / chos sku ste brgyad do/ /rgyan ni bstan bcos 'dis yum gyi don mngon rtogs brgyad gsal bar byas te mkhas pa rnams dga' ba skyed par byed pas na rgyan te/ de skad du/ mdo sde rgyan las/

༄༅/ /gzugs rgyan rang bzhin yon tan ldan pa me long nang song na/ /mthong ba'i dbang gis mi rnams rab tu dga' ba'i mchog bskyed pa/ /de bzhin legs gsung rtag tu rang bzhin yon tan ldan pa khri/ /chos kyang don rnams phye bas mkhas rnams 'di na dga' mchog bskyed/ /ces gsungs so/ /zhes bya ba ni/ bstan bcos 'di la ming 'di skad ces zer zhes pa'o/ /'grel pa ni tshig gi don mdud pa lta bu 'grol bar byed pas na 'grel ba'o/ /'o na ming gnyis la khyad yod na bstan bcos gcig gi ming du 'gal la/ khyad med na bzlos skyon yod do zhe na/ bstan bcos gcig gis yum gyi don myur du khong du chud par byed pas yum gyi man ngag ces bstan la/ mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag gsal bar byed pas mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bstan pas ming gnyis ldog pa tha dad la don gcig pa'i phyir skyon gnyis ka med do / /skad gnyis thog mar smos pas bstan bcos khungs btsun la/ sgra sgyur phra mo shes shing / bstan bcos btsal sla la/ skad gnyis rnam grangs par shes pas so/ /gnyis pa bam po'i grangs ni/gzhung tshad mang nyung bde blag tu rtogs pa'i phyir lo tsā bas byas la/ tshad ni rgya dpe las bstan bcos 'di la sho lo ka stong lnga brgya zhes gsungs pas/ bam po re la sho lo ka sum brgya re yod do/ /dang po ni lnga

yod pa'i thog me rmedi yin zhes 'chad 'gyur la bsnyegs pa ste/ bam kha mar blta dang / le'u'i kha yang blta ba'o/ /'og ma rnams kyang 'di bzhin no/ /gsum pa la sgyur byed lo tsā ba'i mchod brjod/ 'chad byed 'grel pa mkhan po'i mchod brjod/ rtsom byed bstan bcos mkhan po'i mchod brjod dang gsum gyis shes par bya'o/ /dang po ni/ 'grel pa don gsal ba sgyur mkhan gyi lo tsā bas 'grel pa bsgyur ba'i thog mar sangs rgyas thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal bas bsod nams rlabs chen thob cing / dam pa'i spyod pa byas bas 'grel pa bsgyur ba'i bar chad zhi zhing / rang nyid skyes bu dam par rtogs te/ rgya che rol pa las/ bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yi bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub ces gsungs so/ /dang ni 'byed pa'o/ /phyag gi yul ni 'og nas bstan pa las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la dngos dang 'grel pa rtsom pa'i rgyu gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyal sras seng ge bzang pos don gsal rtsom pa'i thog mar yum la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /ci'i phyir du zhe na/ yum de'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas par dag rnam par dbye ba'i phyir du'o/ /dbye ba'i phyir phyag 'tshal na de dbye ba la dgos pa ci zhig yod ce na/ yum de'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa rnams yum kun gyi rgyan du gyur par gsal bar

༄༅/ zhas par bya ba'i phyir du'o/ /phyag 'tshal ba'i dgos pa gzhan yang / 'grel ba rtsom pa'i thog mar yul khyad par can la phyag 'tshal bas bsod nams chen po thob pas/ 'grel pa rtsom pa mthar phyin pa dang / rang nyid dam par shes la de la brten nas rang gis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos la gdul bya gzhan 'jug par 'gyur bar gzigs nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag gi yul yum ni rtsa ba'i mchod brjod yul gyi yum dang 'dra bas 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /ngag don ni rgyal sras seng ge bzang pos don gsal rtsom pa'i thog mar yum la gus pas phyag 'tshal ba chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ khyod la brten nas rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa dbye ba mthar phyin par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rgyal sras seng ge bzang pos rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa rnam par dbye ba chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ khyod la brten nas rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa rnams yum kun gyi rgyan du gyur par gsal bar shes pa'i phyir des na 'grel pa don gsal ni rgyan gyi rgyan yin te/ dper na skyes pa dang bud med la sogs pa'i rgyan gyi dri ma sel ba ni/ de'i rgyan gyi rgyan du 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /de la mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa dang / de'i brjod bya yum thams cad ni 'grel pa don gsal gyi brjod par bya bar yin te/ bshad par bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /

'grel pa don gsal la brten nas rgyan gyi tshig don legs par dbye ba ni/ 'grel pa don gsal gyi dngos kyi dgos pa yin te/ 'grel pa don gsal la brten nas dngos su byung ba'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/'grel pa don gsal gyis rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa rnam par dbye bas rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa rnams yum kun gyi rgyan du gyur par gsal bar shes pa chos can/ 'grel pa don gsal gyi brgyud pa'i dgos pa yin te / rang rgyu 'grel pa don gsal gyi dngos kyi dgos pa las byung ba'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir/ 'brel pa ni 'og nas 'chad pa las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la 'grel pa rtsom pa'i rgyu shes rab dang byas shes drin gzo'i blo dang snying rje dang gsum/ dang po la shes rab kyi rgyu dang shes rab dngos dang gnyis/ dang po la thogs med kyis rnam bshad mdzad tshul/ dbyig gnyen gyis bkrol tshul/ 'phags pa grol sdes phye tshul / btsun pa grol sdes rnam bshad byas pa'i tshul dang bzhis shes par bya'o/ /dang po ni/ 'phags pa thogs med skyob pas bstan bcos chen po'i rnam bshad mdzad do/ /rgyu gang la brten nas na 'gro ba sems can la chags pa ste snying brtse bas kun tu chags pa ste shin tu snying brtse bar mdzad pa dang / mi pham mgon las mdo dang chos lnga gsan pa la brten nas byung ba'i shes rab ste/ thabs shes gnyis la brten

༄༅/ /chang so / /tsa brgyud pa'am dngos su gsan ce na/ thogs med nyid kyis dngos su gsan pa yin no/ /'phags pa thogs med kyis sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje la chags par 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan / yul sems can mi 'dor bar mtshungs/ dgos pa yul sems can mi 'dor bar shes/ dngos la gnod byed theg chen 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi snying rje yin pas so/ /rnam bshad ji lta bu zhig mdzad ce na / yum gyi 'grel pa de nyid rnam nges zhes pa'o/ /bstan bcos chen po ni chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis/ 'phags pa thogs med dang slob dpon dbyig gnyen dag gis skabs brgyad du phye ba med kyi/ don gzhan du rnam rig pa'i grub pa'i mthar rgyal ba'i yum bkrol te zhes yum la bshad gser gling pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mde'i don ma lus pa sdud par byed pas bstan bcos chen po ste/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya'o zhes gsungs pa las/ phyi ma'i rjes su 'brang bar bya ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan 'chad pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir dang / de nyid rnam nges dang yum gsum gnod 'joms sam gzhung 'grel gnyis kyang mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi don 'grel yin pa'i phyir dang / nyi khri snang ba dang rnam 'grel gnyis dngos 'grel yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ngag don ni/ 'phags pa thogs med skyob ba chos can/ nyid

kyis bstan bcos chen po'i rnam bshad mdzad de/ thabs shes gnyis la brten nas de nyid rnam nges brtsams pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gcung dbyig gnyen gyis bstan bcos chen po rnam par bkrol lo/ /dus nam gyi tshe na thogs med kyis rnam bshad mdzad pa de'i 'og tu'o/ /rgyu gang la brten nas na sems can la snying brtse ba dang shes bya don du snang ba nang sems kyi bdag nyid yin pa'i grub pa'i mtha' la yang das par brten nas so/ /ci yum don der gnas pas sam rang nyid mos pas bkrol zhe na/ rang rnam par rig pa'i grub mtha' la mos pa gtso bor byed pas der bkrol gyi/ yum don der gnas pas ma yin te/ yum don dbu ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dbyig gnyen de la yon tan ji lta bu zhe na/ 'gro ba'i don mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i rgyu dge ba'i lam ston par mdzad pas na/ phan bde'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i yon tan mnga'o/ /rnam par bkrol ba ji lta bu zhe na gzhung gi 'grel pa'o/ /ngag don ni gcung dbyig gnyen chos can/ bstan bcos chen po bkrol te/ rnam rig pa'i grub mtha' la brten nas yum gsum gzhung 'grel brtsams pa'i phyir/ /gsum pa ni/ 'phags pa rnam grol sdes kyang bstan bcos chen po rnam par phye'o/ /dus nam gyi tshe na dbyig gnyen gyis bkrol ba de'i 'og tu'o/ /rgyu gang la brten nas na

༄༅/ /sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang yum gyi don rtag chad kyi mtha' spangs pa dbu mar rtogs pa'i blo shes rab la brten nas so/ /de'i yon tan ji lta bu zhe na/ 'phags pa'i khongs su gtogs pa ni 'phags pa dngos yin te/ 'grel chen las/ rnal 'byor sgoms pas don gyi de nyid bsrubs las 'jig rten 'das pa'i shes ldan par/ /skyes gyur blo bzang 'phags pa rnam grol sde yi 'grel pa la ni cher 'bad la/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /sngon chad rnam pa phye zin pas 'di ni rigs pa ma yin no zhe na/ sngar gyi slob dpon gnyis kyis byas pa'i 'grel pa des yum don rnam rig tu bkrol bas yum gyi don ji lta ba bzhin byas pa min par mthong nas yum don dbu mar phye bas skyon med do/ /rnam par phye ba ji lta bu zhe na nyi khri dang rgyan sbyar ba nyi khri snang ba'o/ /ngag don ni/ 'phags pa rnam grol sde chos can/ bstan bcos chen po rnam par phyes te/ thabs shes gnyis la brten nas nyi khri snang ba brtsams pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ btsun pa rnam grol sde yis kyang bstan bcos chen po'i rnam bshad byas so/ /tshul ji ltar na yum dang rgyan gyi bstan bcos kyi tshig don mtha' dag ma rnyed par rang gis rtogs pa dang rjes su mthun par ro/ /dus nam gyi tshe na 'phags pa grol sdes phye ba de'i 'og tu'o/ /de'i yon tan ji lta bu zhe na dad pa'i sa

tshogs lam phal pa la gnas pa'o/ /rnam bshad byas pa ji lta bu zhe na nyi khri dang rgyan sbyar ba nyi khri rnam 'grel lo/ /ngag don ni/ btsun pa rnam grol sde chos can/ bstan bcos chen po'i rnam bshade byas te /——rang gis rtogs pa dang rjes su mthun par nyi khri rnam 'grel brtsams pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa shes rab dngos ni rnyed pa gang yin pa'i 'grel pa de ya mtshan che bas bstan bcos 'byed par spro ba skyes pas bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu shes rab dang ldan pa yin no/ /rgyu gang la brten nas na gong du bstan pa de ltar mkhas pa bzhi'i legs bshad kyis yum dang rgyan gyi don snang bar byas shing / sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas rnyed do/ /gang na 'ga' zhig kho nas te/ dbyig gnyen gyis ma rnyed pa'i bstan bcos yum dang rgyan gyi dgongs pa mtha' dag 'di mtha' bral dbu ma yin pa dang / btsun pa grol sdes ma rnyed pa'i yum dang rgyan gyi don mngon rtogs brgyad kyi rim par mtha' dag 'di ji ltar yin pa de ltar ro/ /dbyig gnyen gyis ma rnyed pa'i bstan bcos yum dang rgyan gyi dgongs pa mtha' dag 'di mtha' bral dbu ma yin pa de ltar brnyed nas brtsams pas de nyid rnam nges dang gzhung 'grel las ya mtshan che la/ btsun pa grol sdes ma rnyed pa'i yum dang rgyan gyi don mngon rtogs brgyad kyi rim pa mtha' dag 'di ji ltar yin par de ltar rnyed nas

༄༅/ /brtsams pas nyi khri rnam 'grel las ya mtshan che la/ nyi khri snang ba la ltos te tshig nyung la don rgyas pas nyi khri snang ba las ya mtshan che bas/ mkhas pa bzhi'i legs bshad dang zlos pa'i skyon med do/ /ngag don ni/ rgyal sras seng ge bzang po chos can/ khyod kyis 'grel pa rtsom pa'i rgyu shes rab yod de/ khyod kyis 'grel pa don gsal 'di/ mkhas pa bzhi'i 'grel pa bzhi las ya mtshan che bar rtogs nas rtsom pa la spro ba skyes te brtsams pa yin pa'i phyir dang / rgyan gyi dgongs pa rnyed nas brtsams pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'grel pa don gsal chos can/ 'grel pa gong ma bzhi las ya mtshan che ste/ yum dang rgyan gyi don mngon rtogs brgyad kyi rim pa mtha' dag rnyed nas tshig bsdus la don rgyas pa dbu mar phye ba'i 'grel pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ shes rab can dbyig gnyen dang / dad pa can btsun pa grol sdes kyang tshang bar mi rnyed pa de lta bas na/ shin tu rnyed par dka' ba zab mo'i lam yum 'di ci zhig ltar te/ dus ring mo zhig nas sangs rgyas kyi byin brlabs kyi dbang gis rnyed pas na/ yum gyi don dbye bar rigs pas yum don 'byed pa'i bstan bcos rtsom pa la spro ba skyes pas na bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu byas shes drin gzo ba'i blo dang ldan pa yin no/ /des na sangs rgyas la byas shes drin gze'i mchod pa bya bar rigs la/

mchod pa'i mchog kyang yum gyi don 'byed pa yin te/ de skad du/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mchog dang po las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bri ba dang klog pa dang nyan pa dang 'don pa dang kha don byed pa dang 'chad pa dang sems pa dang / sgom pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /ngag don ni/ yum gyi don chos can/ shin tu rnyed dka' ba yin te/dbyig gnyen dang btsun pa grol sdes tshang bar ma rnyed pa'i don yin pas so/ /rgyal sras seng ge bzang po sogs yum don la mkhas pa slob pa rnams chos can/ khyod kyis yum don dbye bar rigs te/ sangs rgyas kyi byin brlabs kyi dbang gis yul don rnyed pa'i skyes bu yin pa'i phyir/ rgyal sras seng ge bzang pos sangs rgyas kyi byin brlabs kyis yum don rnyed pa yin na/ sangs rgyas kun la thugs rje snyoms pas ci'i phyir dbyig gnyen dang btsun pas rnyed par ma mdzad ce na/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje snyoms kyang rang gi bsod nams dang blo'i khyad par gyis rnyed ma rnyed byung ba yin te/ dper na lha'i rgyal pos char phab kyang sa bon du mi rung ba la myu gu mi 'khrung pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni/ yum gyi don ma lus pa ji lta ba bzhin sangs rgyas kho nas mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i phyir/ yum gyi don rnam pa kun ji lta ba bzhin seng ge bzang po bdag

༄tsho/ /gi mngon sum gyi spyod yul min na yang byang chub kyi rgyur me tog la sogs pas sangs rgyas mchod pa la sogs pa'i bsod nams sgrub pa dang yum don 'byed pa gnyis/ byang chub kyi rgyur mthun pa'i phyir/rang gzhan la phan gdags 'dod pas yum don 'byed pa'i bstan bcos brtsom pa la spro ba skyes pas na bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu snying rje dang ldan pa yin no/ /spyod yul ma yin na gong du yum don mtha' dag rnyed par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ gong du sangs rgyas kyi dbang gis sam bdag nyid la gzengs bstod pa'am mos pa yid byed kyi dbang du byas pa yin la/ 'dir gzhan la ma ltos par rang dbang du'am khengs bskyungs te 'jug par bstan rnga/'am de kho na nyid yid byed kyi dbang du byas pa yin pas skyon med do/ /ngag don ni/ rgyal sras seng ge bzang po chos can/ khyod kyis 'grel pa rtsom pa'i rgyu snying rje yod de/ khyod kyis rang gzhan la phan par 'dod pa'i sgo nas 'grel pa rtsom pa la spro ba skyes te brtsams pa yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/ nyid kyis yum don phye bas rang dang rang gi gdul bya gzhan la phan te/ nyid kyis yum don phye bas rang gzhan gyi byang chub 'thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i phyir yang na 'di ltar byas te/ rgyan dbye ba'i phyir yum la phyag 'tshal na/ ci slob dpon snga ma'i bstan bcos la ltos nas sam ma ltas par byed/ gnyis pa ltar

na rang dga' brtsams pa'i skyon yod la/ dang po ltar na zlos pa'i skyon yod de/ btag zin pa la yang 'thag pas ci zhig bya/ de'i phyir rgyan dbye ba'i phyir yum la phyag 'tshal ba don med do zhe na/ slob dpon snga ma'i bstan bcos la ltos nas rgyan 'byed pas rang dgar brtsams pa'i skyon med par ston pa ni/ 'gro la zhes pa nas byas zhes pa'i bar ro/ /de ltar zlos skyon yod do zhe na/ zlos skyon med do zhes ston pa na/de ltar nas ya mtshan no zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gal te de ltar yin na gzhan rnams kyi rnam par dbye ba don dang bcas pa'i skabs med par 'gyur ro zhe na/ ma yin te/ slob dpon snga ma dag kyang ston pa la drin du gzo bas sgrub pa'i mchod pa'i ngo bor yum 'di dbye bar rigs so zhes ston pa ni/ de ltas nas dbye ba'i rigs zhes pa'i bar ro/ /slob dpon snga ma'i bstan bcos las ya mtshan che bar rtogs nas yum 'byed na nga rgyal gyi dbang gis rtsom pa yin nam zhe na/ ma yin te/ khengs bskyungs te gzhan la brtse ba'i dbang gis rtsom par ston pa ni/ rnam pa kun tu nas spro ba skye ba zhes pa'i bar ro/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyis bshad na'ang rung ngo / /tshog gsal las/ slob dpon gyi zhal snga nas tshig le'ur byas pa'i 'grel pa ni/ tshigs su bcad pa dang pos phyag 'tshal ba 'grel pa brtsam pa'i dgos pa dang bcas pa bstan to/ /tshogs su

༄༅/ /bcad pa lhag ma bzhis ni sngon gyi slob dpon gyis gzhung ji ltar phye ba bstan to/ /de'i 'ol ma tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshang bar rnyed pa ngo mtshar che bar bdag nyid gzengs bstod pa bstan no/ /de'i rjes su tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis ni rgyal ba'i yum rnyed pa sangs rgyas kyi byin brlabs yin zhing ston pa la drin du gzo bas sgrub pa'i mchod pa'i ngo bor yum 'di dbye bar rigs par bstan to/ /tshigs su bcad pa tha mas ni rang la smad de 'jug pa'i bye brag bstan to/ /de ltar de dag ni 'grel pa brtsam pa la 'jug pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brgyad do zhes so/ /mngon rtogs rgyan gyi bsdus don las/ gal te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yul can gyi rmongs pa bzlog pa ni sngon gyi slob dpon rnams nyid kyis byas zin la/ ma byas so zhe na yang khyod kyis kyang ji ltar byed snyam pa'i dogs pa bsal ba'i don du gsungs pa ni/ 'gro ba'i zhes bya ba la sogs pa'o/ /don ni 'di yin te/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i bshad pa mdzad pa dang ṭīka mdzad pa'i 'phags pa dang slob dpon dag ni/ dngos po dang lam dang rnam pa thams cad bsdus pa yin yang mngon par rtogs pa dang sbyar ba la ma ltos pa'i phyir dang / shes bya nang gi tshul tsam la brten pa'i phyir na rmongs pa rnam pa thams cad du bzlog pa ma yin no/ /

rmegrol pa dang rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i 'phags pa dang slob dpon de dag gis kyang mngon par rtogs pa dang sbyar ba yin yang / kun gyi rgyun du ma gyur pa'i phyir dang ma tshang ba'i phyir na dogs pa ma bzlog pa kho na'o/ /kho bo ni bcom ldan 'das byams pas nye bar bstan pa'i phyir dang / slob dpon rnam par snang mdzad bzang po'i bka' drin las gzhi dang lam dang rnam pa mtha' dag bsdus pas mngon par rtogs pa dang sbyar bas na kun gyi rgyan du gyur pa dang / dogs pa mtha' dag rnam par gcod pas dbu ma dang sbyar ba'i phyir na rmongs pa bzlog pa yin no/ /de skad du yang slob dpon seng ge bzang pos sems can gyi don la mngon du phyogs te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston pa na/ pu sti du ma dag na gdon pa du ma dang / 'chad pa po du ma rnams kyi bshad pa phan tshun 'gal ba mthong bas skyo ba skyes te/ mtha' gcig tu gnas pa na thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das byams pas de'i skyo ba bsal ba'i phyir/ mngon par rtogs pa dang bcas pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma yang bshad do zhes zer ba rjes su thos pa yin no/ /de'i phyir na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yul can gyi rmongs pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ kho bo'i 'di kun gyi rgyun du gyur pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan bshad do zhes so/ /'phags pa thogs med kyis rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu bar/ bstan

༄༅/ /bcos nye bar sbyor bar 'dod pas bdag nyid chos bzhi dang ldan par sbyar nas bstan bcos nye bar sbyar bar bya ste/ sngon gyi slob dpon rnams la nga rgyal mi byed pa dang / sems can la snying brtse ba dang / chos mthun pa ba rnams la byams pa dang / bdag nyid mi sgrogs so zhes gsung pa ltar sbyar bar snang ngo / /gsum pa ni/ nyan thos nas phyag 'tshal zhes pa'i bar gyis ston pa la/ rnam bshad rigs pa las/ mdo rnams smra bar byed pa la/ /ngas ni man ngag sbyin par bya/ /dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang / /tshig don bcas dang mtshams sbyar bcas/ /brgal lan bcas te bsnyad par bya/ /zhes byams pa nyid kyi man ngag brgyud pa ltar/ don rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas 'chad pa la/ dang po mtshams sbyar ba ni/ re zhig ste ston tshul mang po yod pa'i nang nas da lan la/ rgyan 'di la mchod brjod dang dgos 'brel sogs yod pa rnams kyi nang nas dang por yum la spangs rtogs mdzad pa'i yon tan ji ltar yod pa bzhin du brjod pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyi phyag 'tshal ba nyan thos zhes sogs gsungs so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan dam pa rnams ni rang gi bya ba la 'jug pa'i thog mar/ yul khyad par can la mchod par brjod nas rang gi bya ba la 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan dag gis so/ /dgos pa ci'i phyir du na rang don gyi dgos pa ni rgyan rtsom pa po

'phags pa byams pa rang nyid dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun par rab tu ston pas so/ /gzhan don gyi dgos pa ni gzhan mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya rjes 'brang dag ste gnyis/ mtha' thug pas phul du dbyung du med cing tshad kyis dpag tu med pa'i yon tan dgos 'dod stsol bas rin po che lta bu'i 'byung gnas yum bcom ldan 'das ma la rab tu dang ba bskyed pa'i ched du'o/ /gzhan dngas ba bskyed pa'i ched du phyag 'tshal ba dang por ston na dang pa nyid gang gi ched du yin zhe na/ de lta bu'i yum bcom ldan 'das ma la gzung ba la sogs pa'i don du thos sogs kyi sgo nas 'jug par bya ba'i phyir du'o/ /yang na 'jug pa'i ched du'o/ /'jug pa'i ched du dang ba bskyed na 'jug pa nyid gang gi ched du zhe na/ nges par legs pa'i don gyi dbang gis so/ /de lta bu'i yum la zhugs pas nges par legs pa 'thob bam zhe na 'thob ste/ yum bcom ldan 'das ma ni yon tan rin po che thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin pa'i phyir/ gser gling pas dbang phyug dang gzugs bzang ba la sogs pa skal pa drug dang ldan pas sam nyon mongs pa bag chags dang bcas pa bcom pas bcom ldan 'das ma zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad de/ de ltar na byams chos lnga'i mchod brjod yul gyi yum 'bras yum kho na yin pa'i phyir/ byams chos lnga'i lugs kyi skyabs gnas kyang 'bras bu rnam mkhyen kho na yin

༄༅/ /par 'gyur ro/ /'dod mi nus te/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang zhig thog ma dbus mtha' med zhi zhes sogs skyabs gnas gsum gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyas par 'og tu 'chad pa las shes par bya'o / /'phags pa byams pas mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya rjes 'brang gnyis/ yum bcom ldan 'das ma la rab tu dad pa bskyed pa'i ched du dang por phyag 'tshal ba gsungs pa la rgyu mtshan ci yod zhe na/'phags pa byams pa rang nyid kyi rjes thob so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes kyis yum gyi yul can gyi rab tu dang ba ni/ rang 'bras legs pa thams cad 'thob pa'i byed rgyu yin par rtogs pas so/ /chos bshes kyis rgyu'i gtso bo zhes pa ni byed pa'i rgyu nyid do zhes pa ltar legs par mngon no/ /gser gling pas 'thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni/ dngos kyi rgyu yin no zhes gsungs pa ni 'thad par ma mthong ste/ mchod brjod kyi ngag thos pa las byung ba'i dang ba dang 'bras bu byang chub kyi bar du gus 'jug gis chod pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyu'i gtso bo dang po'i rgyu la byas pa'ang 'thad par ma mthong ste/ skabs 'di'i dang ba ni mchod brjod kyi ngag thos pa las byung ba'i phyir dang / mchod brjod kyi ngag thos pa'ang 'bras bu byang chub kyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'ga' zhig gis gzhung 'di mtshams sbyar du byas/ phyag 'tshal ba bshad gzhi byar nas gang zag

gang gis dgos pa ci'i phyir du dus nam gyi tshe yul gang la tshul ji ltar phyag 'tshal bar 'chad pa ni/ mtshams sbyor gyi don ma longs pa'i phyir dang / sangs rgyas nyan thos la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba nas yum de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa dang don gyi khyad cung zad kyang ma byung bas zlos pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir mi 'thad do/ /kha cig 'di mtshams sbyor du mi 'chad par mdo'i 'chad thabs lnga'i nang nas/ bsdus don dang dgos don la 'chad pa ni rnam par 'khyams te/ 'di mtshams sbyor min na 'grel pa 'dir mtshams sbyar gyi tshig gang yang ma smos par thal ba dang / 'og gi de thos nas zhes sogs kyis dgos don dang bsdus don ston pa'i gzhung dang zlos skyon yod do/ /ngag don ni/ 'phags pa byams pas rgyan 'dir mchod brjod dang / dgos 'grel la sogs pa'i nang nas dang por yum la phyag 'tshal ba nyan thos zhes sogs gsungs pa chos can/ rang don gyi dgos pa yod de/ khyod la brten nas 'phags pa byams pa rang nyid dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun par rtogs pas so/ /chos can/ gzhan don gyi dgos pa yod de/ khyod la brten nas mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya yum la rab tu dang ba bskyed pas so/ /mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya yum la rab tu dang ba chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ khyod la brten nas mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya

༄༅/ /yum la thos sogs kyi sgo nas 'jug /zhugs pas legs pa'i mchog thob pa'i phyir/ snga ma gnyis ni dngos kyi dgos pa/ 'di ni brgyud pa'i dgos pa'o/ /'phags pa byams pa chos can/nyid kyis mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya yum la rab tu dang ba bskyed pa'i ched du/ dang por yum la phyag 'tshal ba gsungs pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ nyid kyi rjes thob kyi ye shes kyis yum la rab tu dang ba ni rang 'bras legs pa thams cad 'thob pa'i byed rgyu yin par rtogs nas dang ba bskyed pa'i ched du dang por yum la phyag 'tshal ba gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ltar byed na don gyis 'jug par bya ba'i phyir zhes pa'i don/ yum gzung ba dang kun chub par bya ba la sogs pa'i don du yum la thos sogs kyis 'jug par bya ba'i phyir byas na phyi 'grel dang 'grig go /gnyis pa dgos don la/ dngos dang brgyud pa'i dgos pa dang bsdus te bstan pa dang gsum gyis shes par bya'o/ /dang po la dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang chos kyi rjes 'brang dang ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ mchod brjod kyi ngag bkod pa la dgos pa ci yod ce na/ nyan thos zhes sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'dis ni yum 'di'i yon tan gyi che ba'i bdag nyid gzhan las phul du byung ba dang ldan pa brjod pa de thos pas rkyen byas nas mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba rnams

ni / mchod brjod yul gyi yum 'di la the tshom med par myur du rab tu dang ba skye ba'i dgos pa yod de/ mchod brjod ngag gis yum gyi yon tan brjod pa thos ma thag de'i don la dpyad pa med par yum la rab tu dang ba bskyed pa'i gang zag ni/ mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba yin no/ /re zhig ni go rim mtha' gcig tu ma nges par ston pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ nyan thos zhes sogs kyi chigs su bcad pa nas de thos pas rkyen byas nas mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya dad pa'i rjes 'brang du ma zad chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyang nyan thos zhes sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i brjod bya'i don gyi mtshan nyid de ngo bo gzhi dang lam dang rnam pa rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par yongs su shes pa'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid tshul gsum pa can de la rab tu dang ba bskyed par byed pa ske nyid do/ /gang gi sgo nas na nyan thos zhes sogs kyi drigs su bcad pa'i brjod bya'i don gyi ngo bo gzhi dang lam dang rnam pa rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par yongs su shes pa'i yum mkhyen pa gsum gyis kun rdzob tu rang rang gi sras sangs rgyas dang / sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan rang 'phags pa'i bzhed don bskrun pa la gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'i phyir zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshad ma ste rigs pas gnod

༄7/ /pa ma mthong zhing / kun rdzob tu rang rang gi sras 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don bskrun par mdzad pa ni gdon mi za bar srid do zhes sgrub byed nges par gzung nas so/ /gnod pa ma mthong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya chos kyi rjes 'brang gis yum mkhyen pa gsum gyis rang rang gi sras 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don bskrun pa la gcig dang du bral la sogs pa'i rigs pas gnod pa ma mtherdzong ste/ gcig dang du bral la sogs pa'i rigs pa de don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pa yin la/ yum mkhyen pa gsum gyis rang rang gi sras 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don bskrun pa de kun rdzob pa'i rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir/sgrub byed ji lta bu zhe na/ yum mkhyen pa gsum gyis rang rang gi sras sangs rgyas dang / sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan rang 'phags pa'i bzhed don bskrun pa gdon mi za bar srid de nyan rang gi rigs can rnams kyis rang nyid mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ gzhi thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par bsgoms pas sgom pa yongs su rdzogs pa na nyan rang gi myang 'das gnyis mngon du 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/ gzhan don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yid la byed pas lam thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par bsgoms te lam thams cad

rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par mngon sum du shes shing / theg pa gsum gyi spang rtogs kyi rigs thob pa na sems can gyi don 'bor ba ji srid par mdzad pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob pa na/gdul bya sna tshogs pa nyon mongs pa sna tshogs la spyod pa'i gnyen por chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa rnam pa thams cad du bskor ba'i phyir/ dper na yul dbang yid la byed pa'i rkyen gsum tshogs pa na/ 'bras bu dbang shes 'byung ba gdon mi za bar srid pa bzhin no/ /des na mchod brjod yul gyi yum sher phyin dbye gzhi/ drang don gnas skabs kyi dbang du byas na dbye ngo thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum/ 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gnas skabs theg pa'i tshul gsum pa can/ byed las sras sangs rgyas dang / sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa dang nyan rang 'phags pa'i bzhed don bskrun par mdzad pas so/ /nges don mthar thug 'bras bu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du nges pa yin no/ /dper na drang don gnas skabs skyabs dkon mchog gsum yin yang / nges don mthar thug skyabs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyag gcig tu nges pa bzhin no/ /de skad du/ rgyud bla ma las/ ston pa bstan pa slob don dang / theg pa gsum dang byed gsum la/ /mos pa rnams kyi dbang byas nas/ /skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin/ /spang

༄0/ /phyir bslu ba'i chos can phyir/ /med phyir 'jigs dang bcas pa'i phyir/ /chos rnams gnyis dang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /gtan gyi skyabs gnas ma yin no/ /dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi/ /skyabarnga ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig ste/ /thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ /tshogs kyang de yi mtha' thug phyir/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rgyas par 'og tu 'chad pa las shes par mdzod/ gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid ri nga kral ba la sogs pa'i rigs pa gang zhe na/ gcig dang du bral ni/ dngos por snang ba 'di rnams chos can/ rang bzhin yod pa ma yin te/ gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'i phyir/ dper na sgyu ma'i glang po bzhin no/ /de skad du/ dbu ma shes rab la 'jug pa las/ snang ba'i dngos po 'di yang ni/ /yang dag pa yi rang bzhin med/ /gcig dang du ma dang bral phyir/ /sgyu ma'i glang po ji bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /la sogs pa rdo rje gzegs ma ni/ dngos por snang ba 'di rnams la/ bdag las skye ba yul dus gang na yang yod pa ma yin te/ yod na bskyed bya skyed byed gcig tu thal ba la sogs pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ 'jug pa las/ bdag las skye bar 'dod na bskyed par bya dang skyed byed dang / /las dang byed pa po yang gcig nyid 'gyur na de dag ni/ gcig nyid ma yin pas na bdag las skye

bar khas blang bar/ bya min rgya cher bshad pa'i nyes par thal bar 'gyur phyir ro/ /zhes dang / dngos por snang ba 'di rnams la/ gzhan las skye ba yul dus gang na'ang yod pa ma yin te/ gal te gzhan las skye na me lce las kyang mun pa mthug po 'byung bar thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ gzhan la brten nas gal te gzhan zhig 'byung bar 'gyur na ni/ /'o na me lce las kyang mun pa mthug po 'byung 'gyur zhing / /thams cad las kyang thams cad skye bar 'gyur te gang gi phyir/ skyed par byed pa ma yin ma lus pa'ang gzhan nyid mtshungs/ /zhes dang / dngos por snang ba 'di rnams la/ rang gzhan gnyis ka las skye ba yul dus gang na yang yod pa ma yin te/ gal te rang gzhan gnyis ka las skye na/ gnyis ka la bshad pa'i nyes pa thog tu 'bab pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du/ 'jug pa las/ gnyis las skye ba'ang rigs pa'i ngo bo ma yin gang gi phyir/ bshad zin nyes pa de dag thog tu 'bab pa yin phyir ro/ /zhes dang / dngos por snang ba 'di rnams la/ rgyu med ngo bo nyid kyis skye ba yul dus gang na yang yod pa ma yin te/ gal te rgyu med ngo bo nyid kyis skye na/ pa na se'i shing thog la sogs pa thams cad ni ma pa la sogs pa thams cad las skye bar 'gyur zhing / 'jig rten pa rnams 'bras bu lo thog la sogs pa 'byung

༄༅/ /ba'i ched du 'bad pa mi byed par thal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du/ 'jug pa las/ gal te rgyu med kho nar skye bar lta zhig 'gyur na ni/ /de tshe mtha' dag rtag tu thams cad las kyang skye 'gyur zhing / /'bras 'byung ched du 'jig rten 'di yis sa bon la sogs ni/ /brgya phrag dag gi sgo nas sdud par byed par yang mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de'i phyir dngos por snang ba gang la yang rang bzhin gyis skye ba gang na yang yod pa ma yin te/ rtsa ba shes rab las/ bdag las ma yin gzhan las min/ /gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min/ /dngos po gang dag gang na yang / /skye ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /kha cig na re/ dngos po rnams don dam par gzhan las mi skye yang / kun rdzob tu skye'o zhe na/ kun rdzob tu yang gzhan las skye ba mi 'thad de/ rtsa ba shes rab las/ gang la brten te gang byung ba/ /de ni re zhig de nyid min/ /de las gzhan pa'ang ma yin pa/ /de phyir chad min rtag ma yin/ /zhes dang / tshigs gsal las/ 'jig rten pa'i de kho na nyid kyi mtshan nyid kyi dbang du byas nas brjod par byas te/ gang la brten te gang byung ba zhes sogs dang / 'jug pa las/ gang phyir 'jig rten sa bon tsam btab nas/ /bdag gis bu 'di skyed ces smra byed cing / /shing yang btsugs so

snyam du rtog des na/ /gzhan las skye ba 'jig rten las kyang med/ /ces so/ /rten 'brel gyi rigs pa ni/ dngos por snang ba rnams rang bzhin gyis skye ba yod pa ma yin te/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du/ klu'i rgyal po rgye mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ rkyen las skyes pa gang yin de ma skyes/ /de la ngo bo nyid kyis skye ba med/ /rkyen la rag las gang de stong par bshad/ /gang zhig stong nyid shes de bag yod yin/ /zhes so/ /mchod brjod nga ga gis yum gyi yon tan brjod pa thos nas de'i don la lung rigs kyis dpyad de/ yum yon tan can yin pa la gnod pa ma mthong zhing sgrub byed bzung nas yum la rab tu dang ba bskyed pa'i gang zag ni/ mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin no/ /dad pa'i rjes 'brang gi skabs su 'di la zhes nye tshig dang / chos kyi rjes 'brang gi skabs su de la zhes ring tshig spros pa ni/ dbang rtul ni/ mchod brjod kyi tshig thos ma thag de'i brjod bya la mos nas dang ba chen po skye la/ dbang rnon ni mchod brjod kyi tshig thos ma thag dang ba mi skye bar/tshig de'i don la lung rigs kyis brtags nas yon tan can yin pa la gnod byed ma mthong zhing sgrub byed mthong ba'i sgo nas rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pa'i dang ba skye ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis nye ring gi dzig smos pa yin no/ /kha

༄tsho/ /cig rjes 'brang gnyis ga'i skabs su rab tu dang ba'i don rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pa'i chen po skye ba la bshad pa mi 'thad de/ dbang rtul gyi dad pa rkyen gyis 'phrog srid pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dbang rtul gyi skabs kyi rab ni chen po dang / dbang rnon gyi skabs kyi rab ni rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pa yin no/ /chos bshes ltar na/ mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyang mchod brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i brjod bya'i don gyi mtshan nyid kyi yum de la rab tu ste rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pa'i dang ba skyed par byed do/ /rgyu gang la brten nas na mchod brjod kyi ngag de thos pas rkyen byas nas so/ /gang gi sgo nas na/de lta bu'i yum sher phyin gyis/ sras 'phags bzhi bskrun par mdzad pa gdon mi za bar srid do zhes nges par bzung ba'i sgo nas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan mchod brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i brjod bya'i don gcig dang du bral dang / sogs pa rdo rje gzigs ma dang / rten 'brel gyi rigs pa la sogs pas gdod ma nas ma skyes pa la yid ches par byed pa'i rgyu/ gtan tshigs de dag nyid 'jal bar byed pa'i tshad mas/ gzhi dang / lam dang / rnam pa skye ba med par yongs su shes pa'i yum gyis/ sras gsum bskun pa la gnod pa ma mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /mchod brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i brjod bya'i don gyi ngo bo gcig dang du

bral la sogs pa tshad mas gzhi dang lam dang rnam pa rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par yongs su shes pa'i yum gzhi lam rnam pa rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par shes pa dang ldan pa sras gsum skyed par nus pa'i mtshan nyid can 'di la rang bzhin gyis skye ba yod do/ /sras gsum bskyed pa'i mtshan nyid dang mi ldan no zhes pa'i rigs pa 'ga' zhig gis gnod pa ma mthong ba ni yum 'di'i chos nyid de nyid yin pa'i phyir te/ rgyu mtshan gzhan gang gis kyang btsan thabs su ni de ltar sgrub par mi nus pas so/ /yum la dbye na du yum de'i nus pa de ji lta bu zhe na/ yum sher phyin ni khyad par gyi gzhi'o/ /de'i khyad par ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid ces smos te/ yum de yang kun rdzob tu yang dbyer med pa'o snyam pa dgag pa'i phyir dang / sras gsum char bskyed par bstan pa'i phyir tshig 'di smos te/ klu sgrub kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams dang rang sangs rgyas/ /nyan thos rnams kyis nges brten pa'i/ /thar lam khyod nyid gcig pu ste/ /gzhan zhes bgyi ba ma mchis nges/ /zhes bstod pa dang / brgyad stong pa las/ nyan thos kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslab par bya'o zhes sogs gsungs so/ /de ltar na yum 'di ni nyan rang bskyed pas gang zag la bdag med pa yin la/ byang chub sems dpa' dang sangs

༄༅/ /rgyas bskyed pas gang zag dang chos la bdag med pa yin la de ni dran pa nyer gzhag dang / sdong po bkod pa sogs las kyang bstan pas don lhag pa med pa la/ yum 'di la yang rang rang gi rtogs pa las lhag pa ci zhig yod snyam na/ de bsal ba'i phyir tshul gsum pa can zhes smos te/ don ni yum la mkhyen pa gsum du phye ba ni/ nges don mthar thug rang bzhin gsum du phye ba ma yin te/ dbye bar mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na ci zhe na/ gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang gis sras gsum gyi yum yin no zhes bstan gyi/ nges don mthar thug gi dbang du byas pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kho na'i yum yin gyi/ nyan rang g.yung po la sogs pa lta bu ni/ bud med rin po che lta bu'i yum 'dis ga la bskyed/ de'i phyir yum 'di'i mthu'i che ba ni 'gro ba ma lus pa sangs rgyas kho nar sgrub pas na rab tu ngo mtshar ro/ /yum gyi mthu'i khyad par ston pa'i gzhung dag kyang / gzhung gzhan pas mchog nyid de/ yum 'dir ni rigs can thams cad kyi bstan pa bsgrags pas na gzhung chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i sde yin la/ dran pa nyer gzhag gis ni 'dod chags dang bral ba'i 'jug pa'i rim pa la sogs pa gtso bor ston la/ sdong po bkod pa la sogs pas theg pa chen po'i bya ba'i tshul la sogs pa gtso bor bstan gyi/ nyan rang gi lam dang 'bras bu ma bstan pas gzhung

phyogs gcig pa yin no/ /de ltar na yum sher phyin ni du mar snang ba gcig tu sgrub pa'i mthu dang ldan par bstan pa'i phyir/ tshul gsum pa can zhes spros la/ gcig du mar ston pa'i mthu dang ldan par bstan pa'i phyir/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid ces smos so/ /gser gling pa ltar na/ rang bzhin gyis dbang po rno ba chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams ni bdag la sogs pa bshad pa'i tshig dang 'dra bar bslu ba yod srid pas lung gang la yang bab chol du 'jug par mi byed de/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyang gcig dang du bral la sogs pa'i tshad mas grub pa gzhi dang lam dang rnam pa skye ba med pa yongs su shes pa'i mtshan nyid kyi yum dang / de la brten pa ting nge 'dzin rgyal po la sogs pa'i mdo thos pa la sogs pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa las dad pa phul du byung ba ni rigs pa nyid de gnod pa ma mthong bas phan tshun 'gal bar brjod pa mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig gzhung 'di'i don rab tu dang ba skyed par byed pa nyid do zhes pa bshad gzhir byas nas/ tshul ji ltar dang ba bskyed na shes rab nas nges par bzung ste'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan gzhi dang nas gnod pa ma mthong bas so zer ro/ /kha cig gzhung snga ma gnod byed ma mthong ba dang / phyi ma sgrub byed mthong ba la spyor ba mi rigs zer ba dang / kha cig gnod pa ma mthong ba nyid

༄༅/ /sgrub byed mthong ba yin pas gzhung snga ma gnod byed ma mthong ba dang / phyi ma sgrub byed gzung ba la sbyor bar mi rigs zer ba dang / kha cig gzhung 'dis gnod pa ma mthong ba bstan nas mchod brjod kyi lung sgrub byed yin no zer ro/ /gzhung snga phyi gnod byed ma mthong ba dang / sgrub byed gzung ba la sbyor ba mi rigs zer ba mi 'thad de/ gzhung don nyan thos zhes sogs kyi mchod brjod kyi tshigs bcad chos can / dgos pa yod de/ khyod thos pas rkyen byas nas khyod kyi gdul bya chos kyi rjes 'brang rnams khyod kyi brjod bya yum sher phyin gyis sras 'phags bzhi bskrun par mdzad pa la gnod pa ma mthong zhing gdon mi za bar srid par bzung ste/ yum la rab tu dang ba bskyed pa'i phyir zhes par 'dus pas so/ /dbang rnon dang ba bskyed pa la gnod byed ma mthong zhing lung gi sgrub byed mthong ba tsam gyis chog na de dbang rtul la yang yod pa'i phyir/ dbang snon la chos kyi rjes 'brang dang / dbang rtul la dad pa'i rjes 'brang du 'jog pa'i sgrub byed gang yin smros shig /gnod byed mthong nas dad pa skye ba dbang rtul la'ang mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /des na mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya dbang rtul ni mchod brjod kyi ngag thos ma thag dang ba skyed pas dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang / mchod brjod ngag gi gdul bya dbang rnon ni/ mchod brjod kyi ngag thos ma thag dang

pa mi skye bar de'i don la lung rigs kyis dpyad nas yum yon tan can yin pa la gnod byed ma mthong zhing sgrub byed bzung nas dang ba skye bas chos kyi rjes 'brang du bzhag par mngon no/ /dpyad pa gzhan yang yod de mang du dogs nas ma bris so/ /gnyis pa la/ dang ba las gus pa dang / gus pa las 'jug pa dang / zhugs pa las legs pa'i mchog 'thob pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ thos pa las dang bar ma zad yum de la rab tu dang bas kyang shin tu gus par byed do/ /gang zag gang na yum de'i yon tan zhi bar 'khrid pa dang 'gro ba'i don bsgrub pa dang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba sogs mngon par 'dod pa'i gang zag rjes 'brang gnyis ka yang ngo yang ni sdud pa'o/ /gang la na yum de dang de la brten pa'i gsung rab rjod byed sher phyin nam ting nge 'dzin rgyal po la sogs pa'i mdo'am/ yang na/ brjod bya yum de dang de la brten pa'i gsung rab mngon rtogs rgyan la'o/ /dgos pa ci'i phyir du na lam nyams su len pa'i gnas skabs rnam pa thams cad du tshig gzung ba dang / sogs pa don kun chub par bya ba dang bsgom pa tshul bzhin yid la bya ba dang rang gis rtogs pa bzhin gzhan la yang rgya cher bstan pa la sogs pa'i don du'o/ /mdor na nyan thos zhes sogs mchod brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'di thos pas rkyen byas nas yum la rab tu dang bas gdul

༄tsho/ /bya rjes 'brang gnyis yum la shin tu gus par byed pas dgos pa yod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ dang ba las gus par ma zad de la shin tu gus pas kyang de nas de'i yon tan mngon par 'dod pa'i gang zag gnyis ka yang thos pa las byung ba dang / sogs pa bsam pa dang bsgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab skye ba'i rim gyis de dang de la brten pa'i gsung rab la rnam pa thams cad du gzung ba la sogs pa'i don du 'jug pas dgos pa yod do/ /shes rab gsum ni/ gtso bor bdag rkyen thos pa la brten nas byung ba'i chos rab tu rnam 'byed ni thos byung gi shes rab dang / gtso bor bdag rkyen bsam pa dang bsgoms pa la brten nas byung ba'i chos rab tu rnam 'byed ni/ bsam pa dang bsgom byung gi shes rab yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ gus pa las 'jug par ma zad de'i yon tan mngon par 'dod pa'i gang zag gnyis ka yang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi bdag nyid de dang de la brten pa'i gsung rab la rnam pa thams cad du gzung ba la sogs pa'i don du thog mar thos pa las byung ba'i shes rab skye ba dang / bar du sogs pa bsam pa las byung ba dang / mtha' mar bsgoms pa las byung ba'i shes rab skye ba'i rim gyis zhugs pas kyang legs pa'i mchog byang chub chen po skal ba dang 'tsham par 'thob par 'gyur bas dgos pa

yod do/ /gsum pa ni/ nyan thos zhes sogs mchod brjod kyi tshigs bcad thos pa las rab tu dang ba skyes/ rab tu dang ba las shin tu gus/ gus pa las zhugs/ zhugs pa las legs pa'i cha/chog 'thob par 'gyur ba de'i phyir/ nyan thos zhes sogs mchod brjod ngag gi brjod bya bcom ldan 'das ma la rab tu dang ba'i dad pa ni/ rang 'bras legs pa thams cad 'thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo byed rgyu yin no/ /kha cig na re/ tshigs bcad thos pa las dang ba skye bas thos pa'ang rgyu'i gtso bor bstan rigs so zhe na/ thos tsam/ gyis ngang pa skye ba'i nges pa cheng cing / legs pa'i mchog 'thob pa la nges par rgyu dad pa dgos pas dad pa legs pa thams cad 'thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bor bstan pa yin te/ mdo las/ dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la/ /dkar po'i chos rnams mi 'byung ste/ /sa bon me yis tshig nga la/ /myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa bsdus don ni/ phyag 'tshal ba ste bstod do/ /gang la na nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang sangs rgyas dang bcas pa ste lhan cig pa'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na kun shes nyid kyis nyan thos zhi ba tshol ba rnams nyer zhir 'khrid par mdzad pa dang / lam shes nyid kyis 'gro ba la phan par byed pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams

༄tsho/ /'jig rten sems can gyi don sgrub par mdzad pa dang / rnam mkhyen gang dang ldan pas thub pa rnams spang gnyen theg pa che chung sogs rnam pa kun dang ldan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs pa gsungs pa ste / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan brjod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas so/ /de skad du yang / nyi khri snang ba las/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi dbang du mdzad nas thams cad mkhyen pa rnam pa gsum gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan nye bar dgod pa sngon du 'gro bas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo zhes so/ /gang zag gang gis na/ rgyal tshab byams pa mgon pos so/ /dus nam gyi tshe na/ rgyan la mchod brjod dang dgos 'brel dang lus rnam gzhag sogs yod pa rnams kyi nang nas dang por bstod do/ /gang thugs la bzhag nas bstod ce na/ mkhyen gsum gyi sgo nas yum la bstod pa de la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis ni don mngon rtogs brgyad bsdus la brgyad du ma zad mkhyen pa gsum po de dag kyang dngos btags ma phye ba'i yum yin zhing / brgyad du ma zad mkhyen gsum des kyang 'og drig don rgyas bshad nas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis de bzhin du sras 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don thams cad phun sum tshogs par sgrub nus pa yin pas/ bstod phyag gi yul grangs mang nyung

gang gi yang skyon yod pa ma yin no zhes thugs la bzhag ras so/ /yang na/ mkhyen gsum gyi sgo nas yum la bstod pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ byams mgon chos can/ nyid kyis mkhyen gsum gyi sgo nas yum la bstod pa de la rgyu mtshan yod de/ mkhyen gsum gyis mngon rtogs brgyad bsdus la mkhyen gsum de dag kyang mchod brjod yul gyi yum yin zhing mkhyen gsum des kyang tshig don nas 'chad par 'gyur ba bzhin du 'phags ba'i'i bzheng dom thams cang phur sum tshogs par sgrub nus par thugs la ba'ag zas mkhyen gsum gyi stso nas yum la bstod pa'i phyir/ /yang na ci yum mtha' dag la bstod dam 'on te phyogs gcig la bstod / dang po ltar na sbyor bzhi dang chos sku la ma bstod bas/ bstod pa'i yul nyung la/ gnyis pa ltar na mkhyen gsum gang rung gcig la bstod par rigs pas bstod pa'i yul mang pa'i skyon yod do zhe na/yum mtha' dag la bstod la/ de la bstod kyang mkhyen gsum gyi sgo nas yum la bstod pas bstod phyag gi yul nyung ba'i skyon med de/ mkhyen gsum gyis mngon rtogs brgyad bsdus shing mkhyen gsum des sras 'phags bzhi'i bzhed don thams cad phun sum tshogs par sgrub nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum gyis brgyad ji ltar bsdus she na/ mkhyen gsum gyis mkhyen gsum rang bzhin dang / rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sbyor ba dang /

༄༅/ /rtse mo'i sbyor ba rab dang / mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba go rim dang / skad cig ma'i sbyor ba mtha' dang / chos sku rnam smin gyi sgo nas bsdus so/ /de skad du/ mtshan nyid de yi sbyor ba dang / /de rab de yi go rim dang / /zhes sogs kyi 'grel par bshad do/ /chos bshes ltar na/ mkhyen gsum gyis nyan rang dang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag bsdus pas brgyad bsdus so/ /bsdus tshul gyi bshad pa gzhan la snying po ma mthong bas bzhag go /mchod brjod yul gyi yum gang zhe na/ rang gi sras 'phags pa'i bzhed don sgrub nus ni mchod brjod yul gyi yum gyi mtshan nyid yin pas de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo drang don gnas skabs kyi yum dang / nges don mthar thug gi yum gnyis/ dang po la dbye na gzhung dang / lam dang 'bras bu dang rang bzhin gyi sher phyin dang mngon rtogs brgyad do / /de skad du/ nyi khri snang ba las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de gang yin zhes bya ba 'di ni brjod par bya'o zhe na/ bshad pa/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni/ /dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad nas / /rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag par brjod bya ba yin no zhes dang / nyi khri rnam 'grel las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de du zhig ce na/ de la thams cad shes pas ni nyon mongs pa'i ma rig pa tsam spangs

pa'o / /lam shes pa nyid kyis ni gnyen po thams cad kun nas bskyed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis ni nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i mi shes pa spangs pa yin no zhes pa nas/ gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dbang du byas nas sangs rgyas nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang ldan yum de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes gsungs pa la/ ji lta bu zhig la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya zhes 'dri ba la/ /mngon rtogs bdag nyid bdun yin par/ /shes rab pha rol phyin 'es bya/ /zhes sogs dang / zla 'od las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid mi rnam pa gsum ste/ gang phung po lnga rnams mi rtag par rnam par shes pa'i slob ma dang bse ru dag dang / gang yang slob ma dang bse ru de rnams kyi dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi rnam pa rnams shes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / gang yang de rnams kyi rtogs pa rnam pa de rnams mkhyen pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni sangs rgyas rnams te de'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la'o zhes pa nas/ de ltar kun mkhyen pa gsum gyis mngon par rtogs pa gzhan lnga po rnams bsdus pa'i brgyad char gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang zhes bya ste/ de nyid chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po'i rtogs pa po'i dbye ba la dgongs nas kun mkhyen pa gsum gyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal zhes dang /

༄༅/ /rat+na kin+tis grags pa'i cha las/ 'di skad ces 'bras bu mngon par rtogs par byed pas mngon par rtogs pa ste rgyur gyur pa bdun no/ /mngon par rtogs par bya bas mngon par rtogs pa ste 'bras bu gyur pa gcig pu ste/ de ltar na mngon par rtogs pa brgyad kyi bdag nyid kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin na/ 'dir kun shes ces pa la sogs pa gsum po nyid kyis rab tu dbye bas ci ste phyag 'tshal zhes brjod par ni mi bya ste/ 'di rnams nyid ni dngos po'i rab tu dbye bas phye ba yin la/ gzhan kun ni 'di rnams las spros pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /de bas na gsum po 'di rnams nyid bsdus pa ni mngon par rtogs pa bzhi pa'o/ /rab tu gsal bar song ba ni lnga pa'o/ /go rim du rtogs pa ni drug pa'o/ /gnas skabs kyi dbye bas gcig gi mtshan nyid du rtogs pa ni bdun pa'o/ /'gro ba'i don byed pa'i bya ba dang bcas pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsum gyi bdag nyid ni brgyad pa ste/ de lta bas na gsum po 'di rnams nyid ni dngos po'i rab tu dbye bas phye zhes rab tu rtogs par bya ba'i ched du gsum po 'di rnams kyi rab tu dbye bas phyag 'tshal zhes pa ni skyon med do zhes dang / dag ldan las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dbye ba ni rnam pa gsum yin te/ des na thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbye bas nyan thos zhi ba tshol ba rnams gang thar pa 'thob

par byed pa dang / lam shes pa'i dbye bas 'gro la phan par byed pa rnams te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mdzad par 'os pa ni 'jig rten gyi don te gang 'jig rten gyi don sgrub par byed pa'o/ /lhag mar gyur pa dang don gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbye bas gang dang yang dag ldan pas thub pa ste sangs rgyas so zhes dang / /chos bshes kyis/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gus par phyag 'tshal zhes bya ba smos te/ 'jir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 'es bya ba ri rnam pa gnyis te/ ngo bo nyid dang der brten pa'o/ /ji lta 'e na/ chos rnams kyi nge bzhin nyid 'ji chos rngams las nge nyid dang gzhan nyid du brjod par bya ba ma yin pa ni/ rang bzhin gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste zhes pa nas/ de la brten pa ni lam lnga dang de'i 'bras bu rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang de dag ston pa'i gzhung rnams so zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'bras bu'i yum rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gcig pu'o/ /rgyas par gces btus gzigs/ de gong ma mngon rtogs brgyad la sbyar ba dang / de gnyis pa mkhyen gsum la sbyar ba dang /de gnyis ka brgyad la sbyar ba ni skabs don ma yin te/ kyang gnyis smos pa don med par thal ba'i phyir dang / de rang gi tshig ma yin par thal ba'i phyir ro/ bzhi pa tshig don ni/ gang zag gsum gyi bzhed don

༄tsho/ /sgrub pa'i sgo nas bstod pa dang / sangs rgyas 'khor bcas kyi yum du bsgrub pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba gnyis kyis shes par bya'o/ /dang po la gsum las gzhi shes kyi yon tan brjod pa ni/ mdo las / bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab kyi ri bya rgod phung po na bzhugs te/ dge slong lnga stong tsam gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/dbang du gyur pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba/ cang shes pa/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ bdag gi don rab tu thob pa/srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag par kun shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ sems kyi dbang thams cad la pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog thob pa rnams dang thabs gcig go /gang zag gcig ma gtogs pa ni 'di ltar slob pa rgyun du zhugs pa tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'o/ /dge slong ma grags 'dzin dang / skye rgu'i bdag mo chen mo la sogs pa lnga brgya tsam dang / dge bsnyen dang dge bsnyen ma shin tu mang ba kun kyang chos mthong ba dag dang yang thabs gcig go zhes pa'i don/ khrid pa ste thob par mdzad do/ /gang na rang lugs kyi nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung nye bar zhi zhing sdug bsngal gyi phung po cung zad

lus pa'i dman pa'i 'gog pa ni dman pa'i lhag ma dang bcas pa'i myang 'das dang / rang lugs kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po yang nye bar zhi ba'i dman pa'i 'gog pa ni dman pa'i lhag ma med pa'i myang 'das te rnam pa gnyis so/ /thabs gang gis na gzhi thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par shes pa kun shes nyid kyis so/ /gang zag gang gis na/ nyan thos la so skye dang / 'phags pa gnyis/ 'phags pa la rgyun zhugs zhusas sams ngang / phyir 'ong zhugs gnas ngang / phyir mi 'ong zhugs gnas dang / dgra bcom zhugs gnas te gang zag ya brgyad la/ dgra bcom pa rnams ri lhag med du 'khrid par mdzad la/ dang po bdun la gnas skabs nyan thos su rigs ma nges pa rnams myang 'das su 'khrid mi nus pas/ gnas skabs dman pa'i myang 'das su rigs nges pa'i nyan thos slob pa rnams te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ nyan thos ma nges rnam gnyis te/ /theg don mthong dang ma mthong ba/ /don mthong 'dod chags bral ba dang / /'dod chags bral min 'di dman pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /nyan thos zhi ba 'tshol rnams kun shes nyid kyis nyer zhir 'khrid mdzad ces pa'i tshig gi rim pa gcig gis gnas skabs dman pa'i myang 'das su rigs nges pa'i rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can slob pa rnams kyang shugs la bstan te/ de gnyis thabs

༄༅/ /kun shes pa nyid la brten nas myang 'das su bgrod par mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de gnyis la khyad par gtan med dam zhe na ma yin te/ rang sangs rgyas ni sgra med lus kyi sgo nas chos ston pa dang /phyi rol gyi don bden 'dzin gyi rtog pa spangs pa dang / srid pa tha ma'i tshe slob dpon gzhan gyis gdams ngag bstan pa la ma ltos par rang byang chub mngon du byas pa'i rnam par thar pa cung zad tsam zhig gis nyan thos pas lhag pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na gnas skabs dman pa'i myang 'das su rigs nges pa'i nyan rang gi rigs can zhi ba myang 'das 'tshol ba ste thob par 'dod pa rnams so/ /mdor na thabs kun shes nyid kyis rang gi sras gnas skabs dman pa'i myang 'das su rigs nges pa'i nyan rang gi rigs can rnams dman pa'i myang 'das gnyis su 'khrid par mdzad pas na de de'i yum yin no/ /gnyis pa lam shes kyi yon tan brjod pa ni / mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshad med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dang yang thabs gcig ste/ thams cad kyang gzungs rab tu thob pa/ ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob pa/ stong pa nyid kyis rnam par spyod pa/ mtshan ma med pa'i spyod yul can/ rtog pa med pa'i smon pa dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad la mnyam pa nyid kyi bzod pa rab tu thob pa chags pa med pa'i gzungs rab tu thob pa/

mngon par shes pa shin tu ma nyams pa/ mnyan par 'os pa'i tshig dang ldan pa/ tshul 'chos pa med pa/ kha gsag med pa/ grags pa dang khe dang bkur sti'i sems med pa/ zang zing med pa'i chos ston pa/chos zab mo'i bzod pa dam pa rtogs pa khong du chud pa/ mi 'jigs pa chen po thob pa/ bdud kyi las thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa las kyi sgrib pa rgyun chad pa/ chos rab tu rtogs pas rnam par dbye 'i/nga bstam pa la palas pa bskal pa grangs meng pa mas smon lam lhan tu brtsams pa/ ba'in 'dzum pa dang ldan pa sngon du smra ba khro gnyer med pa/ pha rol la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs su brjod pa la mkhas pa / zhum pa'i sems dang bral ba/ spobs pa mi chod pa/ 'khor 'tha' yas pa zil gyis gnon pa'i mi 'jigs pa dang ldan pa/ bskal ba bye ba mtha' yas pa las skres par 'byung ba la mkhas pa/ chos thams cad sgyu ma dang smig rgyu dang chu zla dang rmi lam dang sgra brnyan dang mig yor dang gzugs brnyan dang sprul pa lta bur lhag par mos pa/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi rgyud dang sems can gyi 'gro ba dang spyod pa dang mos pa phra mo sna tshogs la 'jug par mkhas pa sems can thams cad la sdang ba med pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ bzod pa rlabs po che dang ldan pa/ bdag nyid ji lta ba bzhin du lajug pa la mkhas pa/ sangs

༄༅/ /rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du bkod pa/ mtha' yas pa smon pa dang 'jug pa yongs su bzung ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin rtag tu rgyun mi chad par malhungan du gyur pa/ sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa la gsol ba 'debs pa la mkhas pa/ sems can gyi lta ba sna tshogs dang bag la nyal dang kun nas ldang ba'i nyon mongs pa zhi bar bya ba la mkhas pa/ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam par rtsen pa brgya stong mngon par bsgrub pa la mkhas pa/ yon tan brjod pa bskal pa mtha' yas par mi zad pa dang ldan pa sha stag dang thabs gcig ste/ 'di lta ste byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzang skyong dang / rin chen 'byung gnas dang / ded dpon dam pa dang / skyes bus byin pa dang / chus byin pa dang / dbang pos byin dang / blo gros dam pa dang / khyad par blo gros dang / blo gros 'phel ba dang / don yod mthong ba dang / rab tu zhugs pa dang / rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pa dang / rtag tu rtsen pa dang / rtag tu sbyor ba dang / mi gtong brtson pa dang / nyi ma'i snying po dang / blo gros dpe med pa dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po dang / mthu chen po thob pa dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / rdo rje blo gros dang / lag na rin chen phyag rgya dang /

rtag tu lag rkyong dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dag dang thabs gcig go zhes pa'i don/ sgrub par mdzad do/ /don gang na snod 'jig pa la rten pa 'gro ba mtha' dag gi don mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa rnams so/ /dus ji tsam du na gdul bya'i 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du'o/ /thabs gang yis na lam thams cad rang bzhin yis ma ches par jogs pa'i ngo bo lam shes nyid dus so/ /gang zag gang bis na 'khor ba ji srid par 'gro ba'i don byed pas na 'gro ba la phan par byed pa byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis so/ /mdor na kām shermi kyis tshung chub sems dpa' chen thos /gro don sgrub par mdzad pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i mkhyen skre yin pas ṅge de de'i yum yin no/ /ngag don ni/ lam thams cad shes pa nyid chos can/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa'i yum yin te/ des 'jig rten gyi don sgrub pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir dang / de'i zag med kyi phung po bskyed cing gso bar byed pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'di bzhin gong ma la'ang mdzod/ gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi yon tan brjed pa ni/ mdo las/ de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis gdan seng ge'i khri bshams nas/

༄༅/ /sku drang por bsrangs te dgongs pa mngon du bzhag nas skyil mo krung bcas te bzhugs so/ /der bzhugs nas ting nge 'dzin gang du ting nge 'dzin thams cad khong du chud pas 'du ba dang rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ba ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag go /de nas bcom ldan 'das dgongs shing yang dag par mkhyen pas ting nge 'dzin de las gzhengs te lha'i spyan gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad la rnam par gzigs so/ /de ltar gzigs nas sku thams cad nas 'od rab tu bkye ste/ de'i zhabs kyi mthil gnyis kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa gnyis las kyang 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /zhabs kyi sor mo bcu dang zhabs long bu gnyis dang zhabs byin pa gnyis dang zhabs pus mo gnyis dang zhabs brla gnyis dang / sku sta zur dang sku lte ba'i dkyil 'khor dang sku rtsib logs gnyis dang / thugs ga'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dpal gyi be'u dang / phyag gi sor mo bcu las kyang 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo / /de bzhin du phyag lag ngar gnyis dang dpung pa gnyis dang mgul dang / tshems mche ba bzhi dang tshems bzhi bcu dang spyan gnyis dang snyan gnyis dang shangs kyi sbubs gnyis dang / smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu dang / steng gi spyi gtsug dang zhal gyi sgo nas kyang

'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ste/ 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu po de dag thams cad kyis stong gsum gyi stong chen po 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag thams cad snang ba chen pos khyab par byas te/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /de bzhin du sto dang nub dang byang dang byang shar dang shar lho dang lto nub dang nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang 'og dang steng gi phyogs su phyogs re re zhing 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅga'i klung gi bye ma snyed snang ba chen pos khyab par byas so/ /sems can gang gis 'od zer de mthong ba dang / 'od zer des gang la reg pa gyur pa de dag tham cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chubo tu sngos par gyur to zhes pa nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang lha dang bcas pa bdud dang bcas pa tshangs pa dang bcas pa dge stong dang bram ze'i skye rgu dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'dus shing byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nur gyur pa rnams kyang 'dus par gzigs pa gyur to zhes pa'i don/ gsungs pa ste bskor bar mdzad do/ /thabs gang gis na rnam pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par thugs su chud pa rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pas so/ /ston pa gang gis na sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa yang dag par bsdams pa'i sku can/ phyi rol

༄༅/ /pa'i dbang phyug la sogs pa pas rnal 'byor lhag pas na nyan rang byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni rnal 'byor can gyi dbang phyug go /de rnams las ye shes dang spangs pa dang mdzad pa shin tu rgya che bas de rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bu yin pas gtso bo thub pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rnams kyis so/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la sbyor ba mi 'thad de/ chos kyi sku dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skus theg pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa bskor ba mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /gang na sde snod gsum dang / theg pa rnam pa kun dang ldan pa sna tshogs pa chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa dang chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong po 'di'o/ /dgos pa nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong la spyod pa'i gnyen por chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / theg pa gnyis la rim gyis bkod de smin cing grol bar bya ba'i phyir du chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum mo/ /dus rnam pa thams cad du rgyun ma chad par ro/ /chos kyi phung pa'i ngo bo ni rtogs pa'i chos rgya chen po ston pa'i bstan pa'i chos du ma 'dus pa/ dbye na chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong / de rnams kyi ngo bo/ mdo sde pa tshig yin pas gzugs kyi phung por 'du bar 'dod/ bye brag tu smra ba ming gi rang bzhin yin pas 'du byed kyi phung por 'du bar 'dod/ sems tsam pa nyan

pa po'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i sgrar snang ba'i rnam rig tu 'dod/ chos kyi phung po'i tshad kha cig sh+lau ka drug stong la 'dod/ kha cig phung po dang skye mched dang khams la sogs pa don sna re rdzogs par ston pa'i gtam rgyud re re la 'dod kyang / 'dod chags la sogs pa nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong la spyod pa'i gnyen po( de dang mthun par bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pas/ nyon mongs pa re re'i sanyer po rdzogs par stor pa'i gtam gyi tshogs re yin sno/ /de skad du mdzod las/ chos kyi phung po barbad khri dag /gang rngams thab pas gsungs de dag /tshig gam ming yin de dag ni/ /gzugs dang 'du byed dag tu 'dus/ /kha cig bstan bcos tshad ces zer/ /phung po la sogs gtam re yirno/ — /spyod dro rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ rna/chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs/ /zhes so/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa gsum ni/ dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' don dam yang dag 'phags kyis yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dang por yul wā ra ṇa si drang srong smra ba ri dwags kyi nags su/ nyan thos kyi theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i rnam pa bstan pas chos kyi 'khor lo ngo mtshar med du byung ba sngon lhar gyur pa'am mi gyura'
